name: Porcelain Turntable
description: Control a two-joint brass finger to settle an unpowered porcelain spinner through contact.
natural_language: Begin the study. Push the unpowered porcelain with the two-joint finger. Release both joint torques and settle the painted petal inside the mint sector below the displayed speed limit for 0.8 seconds, then certify rest. Use held A/D and J/L keys in full interaction, or latch each joint torque with the buttons in simplified interaction. Only use screenshots and visible task webpage controls; do not use code, scripts, automation, Developer Tools, console, debugger, inspector, network, source, DOM or page-state inspection, terminal, shell, Python, address-bar or URL/query edits, reload/navigation, browser extensions, external applications, or hidden implementation state. Stay on the task tab; only tabs opened by visible task controls as part of the task may be used.
